 Order
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (439 of Cr.P.C.).

2. The applicant is in custody since 5.4.2024 in connection with Crime No.204/2024 registered at P.S.-Mada Ditrict Singrauli (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 376(3) of IPC and Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that after investigation, charge sheet has been filed and the applicant is in custody since 5.4.2024.
It is urged that the prosecutix and her father have been examined and they did NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:61014 2 MCRC-40253-2024 not support the prosecution story.
Further with reference to the age of the prosecutrix, it is also urged that the prosecutrix herself as well as her father has stated in their depositions that the age of the prosecutrix is 19 years.
Further, after referring to the deposition of PW-3, it is urged that the witness has admitted that the admission register is not paginated and attested.

Further there is no Prahlad Prasad Vishwakarma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191458222/

sentences.text:
No birth certificate has been filed,
therefore the entry as mentioned in the admission register cannot be relied upon.
Further, looking to the testimony of father of the prosecutrix, prima facie it cannot be said that the age of the prosecutrix was 12 years on the date of incident.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.
6. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7. It is directed that the present applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:61014 3 MCRC-40253-2024 2023.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Certified copy as per rules.
